Say what the source is about and what someone would look it up for: its purpose, its main topics, the decisions or facts it holds, and its time span when it has dates.   Write in English. Do not list every item, and never state anything the items do not state.

INPUT: {"source": "DECISIONS.md", "key": "markdown:docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md", "items_total": 4, "items": [{"title": "D-001 · ACCEPTED: Use Postgres 17 with pgvector · docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md", "text": "D-001 | 2026-09-01 | ACCEPTED | **Use Postgres 17 with pgvector** as the only store. The retrieval p95 target is 1,6 s on the VPS. SQLite was rejected because it has no concurrent writers."}, {"title": "D-002 · ACCEPTED: HLM_RESEARCH_ENABLED flag · docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md", "text": "D-002 | 2026-09-10 | ACCEPTED | **HLM_RESEARCH_ENABLED** turns the research librarian on. It defaults to true on the research branch; the release decides whether production enables it."}, {"title": "D-003 · ACCEPTED: Memory Map budget · docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md", "text": "D-003 | 2026-09-12 | ACCEPTED | The Memory Map budget is about 6k tokens. Summaries take at most 40 % of it and a large document is truncated by spreading, never by cutting its head."}, {"title": "D-004 · ACCEPTED: new retrieval latency target · docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md", "text": "D-004 | 2026-09-20 | ACCEPTED | The retrieval p95 target is now 1.2 s (it was 1,6 s in D-001), measured by the G4 latency gate on the production VPS. The owner decided it after the R3 release."}]}

message.content: {"summary":"Accepted architecture and retrieval decisions dated 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-20. Consult for the Postgres 17 with pgvector-only storage choice, the HLM_RESEARCH_ENABLED flag, Memory Map budget and truncation rules, and the updated 1.2 s retrieval p95 target measured by the G4 latency gate after the R3 release."}
